prompt:
Part 1
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the elf-eared girl from <Picture 1>, with short tousled blonde hair, amber eyes, freckles, pointed ears, a white short-sleeved shirt, cream knitted vest, striped tie, dark plaid skirt, white socks and black loafers.
<Picture 2> provides the school corridor setting, natural daylight, candid smartphone framing and playful expressions.

summary:
[reference generation] An 8-second vertical 9:16 school-life vlog filmed by a friend in one continuous handheld take. <Subject 1> notices the camera, turns naturally toward it, smiles and playfully covers the lens with her right palm. Cute, spontaneous and physically realistic.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (entire shot): fully_preserved — preserve her facial identity, body proportions, pointed-ear shape, hairstyle and complete outfit.
<Picture 2> (entire shot): partially_preserved — use its corridor atmosphere, lighting and candid photographic style as full-screen footage without collage borders.

detailed_description:
Realistic smartphone video at normal speed, with soft daylight entering through corridor windows, natural skin texture and ordinary background detail. Cuteness comes from subtle expressions and relaxed interaction with the friend filming. Handheld motion consists of gentle breathing sway, small framing corrections and believable footstep movement.

[Shot 1] During seconds 0–2, the camera begins approximately one metre away, slightly behind <Subject 1>’s right shoulder at roughly her eye level, framing her from the waist upward. She stands facing along the corridor with her arms relaxed. She notices the phone: her eyes move toward it first, then her head turns comfortably to the right, followed by a small shoulder rotation. The operator remains stationary and follows with a small, slightly delayed pan. Her hair tips respond lightly to the turn and settle.

During seconds 2–4, she turns toward the camera using two small repositioning steps. Each foot lifts before changing direction; her hips and shoulders follow the movement as her weight transfers naturally. The operator makes a short sidestep around her right side toward a front-right viewpoint, then takes one small forward step, reaching a chest-up composition at comfortable arm’s reach. The movement follows a clear path without crossing her feet. She meets the lens and forms a shy, closed-mouth smile.

During seconds 4–6, the operator stops walking and holds the phone with relaxed elbows. <Subject 1> raises her right hand from her side in one continuous movement. Her elbow extends gradually, her wrist remains comfortably aligned and her palm faces the lens with five relaxed, naturally separated fingers. Her hand approaches from the lower-right foreground while her face remains visible. Her smile becomes slightly more playful. The camera stays in place with only gentle handheld sway.

During seconds 6–8, her palm moves closer and slows before reaching the phone. It grows larger through perspective and becomes softly out of focus at close range. Her hand progressively blocks her face and then the corridor, maintaining correct depth and occlusion. She gently covers the camera opening without striking or passing through the phone. A barely perceptible contact nudge is followed by a stable, fully obscured dark warm-toned frame for approximately the final half-second.

Apply strict real-world physical constraints throughout. Preserve stable facial geometry, body volume, limb lengths and anatomically correct joints. Head rotation is shared naturally with the shoulders and torso. Feet support her weight without sliding or penetrating the floor. Hands retain five fingers and remain correctly connected to the wrists. Hair and fabric respond subtly to gravity and acceleration. Pointed ears retain their shape and attachment. All movement accelerates and decelerates continuously. No morphing, extra limbs, fused fingers, clipping, teleportation, sudden pose changes or extreme neck rotation. Use physical camera movement without digital zoom, artificial orbiting or exaggerated shake. No cuts, slow motion, dialogue or on-screen text.

overall_soundscape:
Quiet corridor ambience, distant indistinct chatter, light shoe contacts and subtle sleeve rustling. A faint handling sound accompanies the palm covering the phone, slightly muffling the ambience at the end.

Part 2
subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the same elf-eared girl from <Picture 1>, with identical facial features, short blonde hair, amber eyes, freckles, pointed ears and the same complete outfit.
<Picture 2> provides the school corridor setting, daylight, candid phone framing and cute everyday expressions.

summary:
[reference generation] An 8-second vertical 9:16 school-life vlog continuation filmed in one continuous handheld take. Starting with her right palm covering the lens, <Subject 1> reveals her smiling face, gestures for her friend to follow, walks along the corridor and gives a gentle backward glance.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (entire shot): fully_preserved — maintain her identity, anatomy, hairstyle and clothing consistently.
<Picture 2> (entire shot): partially_preserved — use its corridor atmosphere and candid visual style without reproducing the collage layout.

detailed_description:
Realistic smartphone footage at normal speed. Match the first clip’s corridor, window-light direction, colour balance and eye-level phone viewpoint. Keep her expression cute and understated. Use subtle breathing sway when stationary and light footstep-driven movement while following.

[Shot 1] During seconds 0–2, the opening image is fully obscured by <Subject 1>’s right palm, producing a dark warm-toned frame. She stands facing the stationary phone at comfortable arm’s reach. After a brief covered opening, she withdraws her palm by bending her elbow, then lowers her forearm. The hand decreases in apparent size continuously; the corridor and her face emerge naturally around its edges. Focus settles on her face and exposure adjusts gently as the lens clears. The operator makes one small framing correction. She looks directly into the camera with a pleased, closed-mouth smile.

During seconds 2–4, she holds her right hand briefly at waist height, palm loosely upward, and makes one small inviting movement toward herself with relaxed fingers. The operator tilts down slightly to include the gesture, then returns the framing toward her face and shoulders. She lowers her arm and turns toward the corridor using small repositioning steps, lifting and replacing her feet in sequence. Her hips, shoulders and head follow the turn comfortably. The operator remains in place, giving her space to move.

During seconds 4–6, she begins walking at an easy pace. Once space opens, the operator follows slightly behind her right side, maintaining approximately one metre of separation and framing her from the hips upward. Short, even camera-operator steps produce restrained vertical bob and slight lateral sway. Her arms swing gently in opposition to her steps. Her shoes make clear floor contact, while her hair and skirt respond with small delayed movements. The corridor remains visible around her.

During seconds 6–8, she slows, and the operator decelerates with her. Her eyes move toward the phone before a modest backward head turn over her right shoulder, accompanied by a small shoulder rotation. The operator stays behind her right side, where her three-quarter face is naturally visible, and makes a small pan to follow her glance. She gives a warm smile, then starts looking ahead again. The camera resumes a gentle forward follow as the clip ends.

Apply strict real-world physical constraints throughout. Preserve facial structure, body proportions, limb lengths and hand anatomy. Maintain five fingers per hand with natural joint articulation. Weight transfer supports every step; feet never skate, float or pass through the floor. Turns use coordinated foot placement, hip rotation and shoulder movement without twisting planted legs. Keep neck rotation comfortable. Pointed ears remain stable and attached. Hair and clothing obey gravity and do not intersect her body. The opening palm correctly occludes and reveals the scene without merging into her face. Preserve continuous acceleration, deceleration and camera inertia. No morphing, duplicated limbs, reversed joints, abrupt pose changes, digital zoom or exaggerated shake. No cuts, slow motion, dialogue or on-screen text.

overall_soundscape:
Begin with slightly muffled corridor ambience that becomes clearer as the palm withdraws. Continue with distant indistinct chatter, soft clothing movement and footsteps synchronized with visible footfalls.
